message:
The retrofit job is split into six functions on the whiteboard, from capturing motion and supplying force through dissipating energy and transferring loads to limiting travel and keeping the deck look unchanged.

Structural Dynamicist, Bridge Retrofit Engineer, Pedestrian Comfort and Safety Assessor, Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead first bring the best existing solutions from your fields with source as concepts, then post one concept for every function or state your field has none for it. Structural Dynamicist will turn the stated span and mode into modal mass and stiffness with calc and will prove vibration decay over time with simulate, while Pedestrian Comfort and Safety Assessor will prove acceleration comfort over time with simulate. The numbers that decide this are 40 m span and 1.9 Hz first mode.

My position is not ready, because no concepts or evidence have been posted yet.
